name: Instagram Story: 4 Images
description: A story template with four images in a dynamic animated layout. Good for collections and multi-product features where editing down to one image isn't an option.

name: Instagram Story: 5 Images
description: A story template that moves through five images in a flowing animated sequence. Good for event recaps and collection launches.

name: Instagram Story: Blog Post
description: A story template designed for sharing blog post highlights with animated text reveals. Good for content creators and media brands driving traffic to written articles.

name: Instagram Story: Browse More
description: A story template with an animated swipe-up prompt. Great to use for driving content discovery and directing traffic from stories.

name: Instagram Story: Fashion
description: An editorial story template with strong visual hierarchy and a fashion-forward feel. Good for clothing brands and style-focused social media posts.

name: Instagram Story: Pastel
description: A pastel-toned story template with gentle animations that don't compete with the content. Ideal for lifestyle brands and aesthetic-forward social media content.

name: Mirror: Social Media Showcase
description: A showcase template where content is reflected symmetrically across a mirrored layout. Works for portfolio reels and brand content with a bold visual structure.

name: Orbit: Social Media Showreel
description: A showreel template from Rico where content pieces orbit around a central point in a continuous loop. Great for portfolio presentations and social media showcases.

name: Product Of The Week [Product Hunt]
description: An animated Product Hunt badge template for product launch announcements. Great for launch day social posts and milestone content.

name: Project Reveal
description: A reveal template from Vendredi Society that builds gradually before showing the work. Good for portfolio drops and project announcements where you want to create a sense of anticipation.

name: Project Teaser
description: A cinematic project teaser template from Vendredi Society with a slow build and dramatic reveal. Great for portfolio drops and project announcements where you want to create anticipation.

name: Revolve: Social Media Showcase
description: A showcase template where content rotates into view with a smooth spinning motion. Works well for social media reels and portfolio presentations in portrait format.

name: Slideshow: Social Media Showreel
description: A slideshow template with smooth transitions between frames sized for social media. Great for portfolio content on Instagram and similar platforms.

name: Spiral: Social Media Showcase
description: A showcase template where content enters the frame with a spiral motion. Good for social reels and portfolio content that needs a bit more visual energy.
